datasets.title: Nyarugenge district boundary candidate
datasets.description: District boundary candidate dissolved from the NISR village_boundary service. The accessible service metadata does not specify its vintage, and NISR Hub’s separate Village_Boundary_2022 layer was inaccessible during verification.
datasets.sourceName: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
notes: The accessible NISR village_boundary service returns this geometry and official administrative identifiers, including Nyarugenge district_id 11.
NISR Hub separately lists a Village_Boundary_2022 service. Its direct REST layer metadata and query returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-23, so equivalence to this accessible service is not confirmed.
Derived output is withheld from app map layers until NISR confirms the vintage and reuse terms.
datasets.referencePeriod: Vintage not stated in accessible service
datasets.license: No separate license text found in accessible service metadata; confirm terms with NISR.
datasets.processing: Union of 350 NISR village polygons; EPSG:32736 metric operation; 2 m topology-preserving simplification; EPSG:4326 web output.
datasets.validationStatus: Geometry, coverage, district ID 11, and administrative IDs validated. Exact vintage/equivalence and reuse terms remain unresolved.

datasets.title: Population age groups, marital status and age at first marriage
datasets.description: Nyarugenge-specific gender tables transcribed from the NISR Gender Statistics Profile; source table, population universe and units are preserved per row.
datasets.sourceName: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
datasets.license: NISR publication; attribution retained. No separate reuse license stated on attachment page.
datasets.units: residents, percent, and years (specified per row)
datasets.validationStatus: 34 machine-extracted table rows; expected district values and table counts checked against PDF text/tables.
notes: Age-group counts and shares: Table 1, printed p. 17 / PDF p. 18; shares are of total district population.
Marital status percentages: Table 2, printed p. 19 / PDF p. 20; universe is residents aged 12 and above.
Mean age at first marriage: Table 3, printed p. 19 / PDF p. 20; definition and universe are retained in each row.
NISR labels report Gender Statistics Profile 2023; source figures refer to the 2022 census.
